method: per stem: band energy shares (kick<130Hz, snare 150-1200Hz bp@400, hats>5kHz), onset flux peak-picking, tempo via onset-envelope autocorrelation 55-200bpm folded to 60-180, 16-slot grid via best-phase quantization (+-45ms), swing from off-8th residuals; mix: chroma (FFT 8192 @22050, 55-2200Hz) + Krumhansl key correlation - identical to the measured_canon pipeline

renderable_counterparts.progression: in_space (data/recovered_music.json, engine_study tier - harmony is chroma-derived, NOT a transcription)

limits: SoundCloud transcodes can decode above 0 dBFS; levels are relative evidence only
key estimate is single-method (Krumhansl, r=0.51 is weak); chroma peaks E/F/G/A guided the study voicings
swing assumes off-8th placement; the 16-slot grid is best-phase within +-45 ms, so slot placement is the analyzer's phase, not a score
sample identity of the record is unverified; no artist harmony is claimed
